name: Ex Astris
source:
Set in a ‘near-future’ on a fictional world, Ex Astris follows the story of Lanis Rosenberg, a newly graduated doctor working in the Loennian military. Doubtful of her abilities to cope in the army and lost with her direction in life, Lanis’ world is suddenly turned upside-down when she is transferred to the secretive, militaristic nation of Xian. There, she is assigned to a subject named A-28 'Ash'. An emotionless, biologically engineered soldier and her opposite in every way…

*Released as kinetic, episodic VNs.

[From [url=https://exastris.carrd.co/]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
《Ex Astris》的故事发生在虚构世界的“近未来”。刚毕业的医生拉尼斯·罗森伯格加入了洛恩尼亚军队。她怀疑自己是否有能力适应军队生活，也对人生方向感到迷茫；就在这时，她被调往神秘而军事化的国家西安，人生骤然天翻地覆。

在那里，她被分配负责一名编号为A-28、代号“阿什”的对象。那是一名没有感情、经过生物工程改造的士兵，几乎与她处处相反……

本作以动态小说形式分集发行。

[来自[url=https://exastris.carrd.co/]官方网站[/url]]
